Mit Stützpunkten läuft der Radius durch: With control points the radius runs through the given values (position in % of the edge length). This is computed by the full geometry kernel; the first time it takes a few seconds to load.
Alle Flächen wählen, die verschwinden so: Select all faces that are to disappear (for a pocket the walls and floor, for a hole the wall, for a fillet the rounded face). The neighbouring faces are extended across the gap. The step recomputes when the body changes; the first time the full geometry kernel is loaded for this (a few seconds).
Die gewählte ebene Fläche wird durch die: The selected planar face is replaced by the target plane: the body grows up to it or is shortened to it, the side walls continue straight. With an inclined construction plane the face becomes slanted.
Nur dort, wo das Referenzwerkzeug nicht: Only where the reference tool could not reach: shallow areas parallel, steep areas as waterline. With a tool from the list its shape counts too – for example what a bull-nose cutter leaves in the fillets.
Ein runder Fräser lässt in jeder Innenec: A round cutter leaves its radius in every inside corner – a square mating part will then not fit in. The relief moves briefly into the corner and back at every sharp inside corner.{0}{1}
